## Mistake-proofing high performance cardiac arrest trolleys.

:::: {.justify}

Poka-yoke (ポカヨケ); mistake-proofing.

When a patient's heart stops in hospital, staff fetch equipment from a
resuscitation trolley: a set of drawers holding airway devices, needles, drugs
and other items. Every second counts, so the right item needs to be in the right
place, in date, and quick to find. Trolleys are checked every day, but checking
a drawer full of small items is easy to get wrong. Trolleys in different parts
of a hospital can also be laid out differently, which slows down staff who move
between wards. We want to test a simple idea. Each drawer gets a foam insert
with a shaped space for every item, and a photo of the item at the bottom of
that space. If something is missing, the empty space and photo show it straight
away.

This multi-staged project uses audit, novel research ideas and implementation science. We aim to pre-register our approach and publish our findings regardless of what they show.
